text: いろんな　タイプの　ポケモンに　かち　まくる　ような　コンビネーションを　さがした！

structure.jp: いろんな　タイプの　ポケモンに
かち　まくる　ような
structure.en: the kind that wins again and again

structure.jp: コンビネーションを　さがした！

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる after the middle form of a verb means doing it over and over, without holding back. かち　まくる = 'win again and again'.

patterns.name: 〜ような
patterns.span: かち　まくる　ような
patterns.explanation: ような before a noun means 'the kind of thing that is like this'. かち　まくる　ような = 'the kind that would keep winning'.
